messages:
maria: Quick update — Blazar HW team sent over a marketplace preview request + draft NDA. They want a small early-access listing and a short perf benchmark before Tuesday :alarm_clock:

sam: can you drop the NDA link? i'll size a dedicated test pool and prep the image. do we need special kernels?

maria: https://files.blazar.com/redwood-nda-v2.pdf — legal flagged a few clauses around telemetry. also they attached a perf spec doc.

kevin: adding QA notes — we should run 3 workloads: 1) 1k-token chat spike, 2) embedding generation (128 dim), 3) bulk rerank 10k queries. capture p50/p95/p99 + GPU util. nothing fancy.

anne: read the NDA. telemetry clause ok with edits — we need explicit allowed fields (latency, error rates, model id); remove any customer PII sharing. sending redline in a sec. :pencil2:

raj: for marketplace packaging — do we want to submit both a quantized and float variant? marketplace prefers single entry but allows variants. my suggestion: publish the q4_8 variant as "preview-optimized" and float as fallback.

caroline: from partner ops — Blazar will provide access keys and a test rack (2xA100-equivalent). they asked that our benchmark harness runs under their lab network. we should ensure our telemetry uses ephemeral IDs.

sam: infra note: we need a kernel build with nvllama-ops v1.3 and a fallback to nv-compat v0.9. i'll stage images on staging-3, tag as blazar-preview-1758. the launch script below is what I'll run:

```bash
# staging image deploy
redwood-deploy --cluster staging-3 --image redwood/blazar-preview:1758 \\n  --kernels nvllama-ops:v1.3 --env REDWOOD_MODE=preview
```

kevin: share the harness link so we can add the 10k rerank job. prefer to run jobs with --concurrency 8 to simulate production.

maria: harness here: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/blazar-marketplace-harness (private) — config in the sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/blazar-preview-config

anne: also need a short customer-facing blurb for marketplace listing that legal vets. maria — can you draft a 1-2 sentence summary of the preview constraints (NDA, limited region, no production SLA)?

maria: draft: "Blazar Preview: Early access to Blazar-accelerated inference. Limited run, NDA required; performance characteristics under lab conditions. Contact partnerships@redwood.ai to join."

caroline: thumbs up. i'll include that in the marketplace submission form.

raj: telemetry spec: export metrics to partner bucket + redwood observability. must be toggled per-run. sample env var: BLZ_TELEMETRY=off|partner|redwood. set default to partner for preview.

kevin: small blocker — our harness currently uploads raw logs to s3. anne — legal needs that masked. can we change to summary metrics only?

anne: yes, require mask-first. set policy: no request/response bodies off-box. only aggregate stats + hashes. i'll put exact wording in redline.

sam: timeline check — if NDA signed by monday AM, infra can run first pass Tuesday, QA Wed, and we can submit marketplace listing Thursday for Blazar approval. sound feasible?

maria: +1. asking Blazar for NDA sign by EOD today. pinging them now. @deploy-bot can you open a checklist ticket for this preview?

deploy-bot: Created ticket RED-5432: Blazar marketplace preview — NDA / benchmark / telemetry checklist. Assignee: maria. Due: 1758290000. :white_check_mark:

caroline: i'll coordinate partner comms and let channel know once listing draft is submitted.

kevin: i'll prepare the rerank job and a small script to capture p50/p95/p99 and GPU temp. will post results in the ticket.

maria: perfect. last ask — can someone volunteer to own the benchmark report (one-pager) we hand to Blazar? i can draft but need sign-off from kevin and anne.

kevin: i'll co-own the numbers.

anne: i'll sign off on telemetry & wording once draft is in ticket.

maria: great — closing loop. i'll update thread when NDA accepted and attach redline. :sparkles:
